text:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — there are a few leftover conference hoodies on the kitchen shelf `B2`. Grab-and-go at 4pm, please only take the size you need :tada:
Jamal: Ooh thanks, need a medium if any left! :raised_hands:
Alex: Mediums are my jam. Can you stash one for me, @Olivia? :pray:
Olivia: @Alex I can save one but only if you promise to stop hiding my whiteboard markers :laughing:
Maria: Quick PSA — don’t put hot drinks on Shelf B2, the hoodies are delicate. Learned that the hard way. :coffee:
Jamal: Also, left a sticky note with sizes on the shelf. If you grab one, please cross it out so we don’t double-claim. Simple democracy. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Will do. If anyone wants to trade for a slightly questionable conference mug, I’m open to negotiations. :mug:
CoffeeBot: Inventory alert: 3 hoodies remaining (S, M, L). First-come-first-served. :package:
Olivia: Thanks @CoffeeBot — I’ll be by at 4 to move the extras to the bench so folks don’t rummage through the snack drawer. :+1:
Maria: Kudos to @Olivia for organizing the swag table. Also, jam from the meeting is still in the fridge if anyone’s low-sugar craving hits. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Jamal: Appreciate it! See you at 4. :wave:
